definition_one_sentence: A customer with at least one non-cancelled order during the trailing 12 months.
formula_or_rule: Exists order with status != cancelled and order_date >= as-of date minus 12 months.
example: Order on 2026-06-10 qualifies on 2026-11-25 if not cancelled.
notes_conflicts: Finance definition adopted as company standard; Sales uses a separate 6-month “recently active customer” segment, not a conflicting definition.

definition_one_sentence: Order revenue after refunds, excluding VAT, while shipping fees remain included.
formula_or_rule: (gross order amount − refunds) / 1.20, rounded to 2 decimals; assumes 20% VAT.
notes_conflicts: Finance definition selected; Sales may analyze gross customer-paid values including VAT separately.

definition_one_sentence: An account with no non-cancelled order during the trailing 12 months.
formula_or_rule: No qualifying order (status != cancelled) in the prior 12 months.
example: Last qualifying order 2025-10-01 → churned as of 2026-11-25.

definition_one_sentence: A ShopFast account identified by customer_id and used to associate purchases and account attributes.
formula_or_rule: One account per customer_id; multiple accounts may belong to one person.
example: customer_id 10410 identifies an account, not necessarily a unique natural person.
notes_conflicts: Account-level entity; do not equate account count with unique people.

definition_one_sentence: A customer purchase request recorded by ShopFast with a unique ID, date, channel, destination and status.
formula_or_rule: One order record per order_id in stg_orders.
